extracted.intended_audience: hospital administrators, quality measurement professionals, CMS staff, and measure developers
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and technical guidance and specifications used in CMS rulemaking for hospital-level quality measures, including measure reporting formats, exclusions, voting/endorsement procedures, and eligibility definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Z-score standardization
rubrics_metrics.description: Z-score standardization is a commonly used approach that translates hospital results into a common scale, indicating how each hospital's performance compares with the overall average.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This approach helps reduce the impact of extreme values and differences in scoring methods, while supporting fair and consistent comparisons across hospitals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-Rulemaking Measure Review voting options
rubrics_metrics.description: In 2025, the CBE updated the Pre-Rulemaking Measure Review voting process such that committee members will vote to either “recommend” or “do not recommend” that a measure be added to the intended CMS program(s), thus, removing the “recommend with conditions” voting option.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Committee members can provide considerations for CMS to review prior to implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-Rulemaking Measure Review consensus threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: The threshold to reach consensus on a given measure continues to be a minimum of 75 percent agreement among members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A minimum 75% agreement is required for consensus; members may still provide considerations for CMS even where consensus is reached or not reached.

rubrics_metrics.name: QRDA I reporting standard for eCQM
rubrics_metrics.description: QRDA I is an individual patient-level quality report that contains quality data for one patient for one or more eCQMs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: QRDA creates a standard method to report quality measure results in a structured, consistent format and can be used to exchange eCQM data between systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsible entity for third-party submitted data (PCH responsibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: The PCH remains responsible for ensuring the data submitted by a third party is true, accurate, and complete.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even when data are submitted by an external third party, the submitting PCH (provider/center/hospital) retains ultimate responsibility for data integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion of COVID-19 admissions from certain outcome measures
rubrics_metrics.description: Exception: Subsequent inpatient admissions with a principal diagnosis code of COVID-19 (U07.1) or with a secondary diagnosis code of COVID-19 coded as present on admission on the claim within the seven/30-day time frames are not eligible for use by the measure (and are excluded) in determining whether AMI, pneumonia or other acute respiratory complication, sepsis/septicemia/shock, or pulmonary embolism occurred.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The code list used to define the “Mechanical Complication” outcome includes 26 codes that reflect fractures and periprosthetic fractures; COVID-19 related subsequent admissions are excluded from numerator/denominator determinations as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'Primary' joint replacement for measures
rubrics_metrics.description: “Primary” refers to an initial joint replacement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The measure does not assess revision joint replacement procedures; only initial (primary) replacements are in-scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rule for pooling episodes to determine HCPCS exclusion thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: To determine if a drug HCPCS meets the cost or volume thresholds for exclusion, the episodes are pooled across all episode categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When applying cost/volume exclusion criteria for HCPCS drugs, compute pooled episode counts/costs across categories rather than by single category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diagnosis-Related Category formation (MDCs)
rubrics_metrics.description: MDCs are formed by dividing all possible principal diagnoses (from ICD-10-CM) into 25 mutually exclusive diagnosis areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The diagnoses in each MDC correspond to a single organ system or etiology and in general are associated with a particular medical specialty.

rubrics_metrics.name: HCAHPS quality assurance adherence
rubrics_metrics.description: For full details, see the current HCAHPS Quality Assurance Guidelines, V.19.0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure implementers and reporters should follow the HCAHPS Quality Assurance Guidelines as posted on the official HCAHPS On-Line website for survey administration and QA.

rubrics_metrics.name: TEAM Track 2 participant eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: TEAM participants eligible for Track 2 include safety net hospitals, rural hospitals, Medicare dependent hospitals, Sole Community Hospitals, and Essential Access Community Hospitals, all defined at § 512.505.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility is limited to the specified hospital types as defined in the cited regulation section; implementers should consult § 512.505 for definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost report filing responsibility by provider type
rubrics_metrics.description: THs complete the hospital cost report, form CMS-2552-10 (OMB No. 0938-0050) and IOPOs and HCLs complete cost report form CMS-216-94 (OMB No. 0938-0102).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific provider types must use the designated CMS cost report forms for Medicare cost reporting; see cited PRM chapters for procedural details.
